maxDevicesPerBranchByModel.note: Values at 20 A / 240 VAC. 13 (IQ8/IQ8+) is well-sourced; IQ8M/IQ8A/IQ8H numbers are from per-model datasheets and should be field-verified against the exact model datasheet. Local AHJ may further limit.

branchOcpdNote: Each microinverter AC branch circuit must be protected by a 20 A maximum breaker or fuse (NEC). Branch OCPD is the limiting factor on devices per branch, not the cable ampacity.

spliceInstallRule.realRule: The IQ Q-Cable is one continuous, factory-connectorized reel with an integrated AC drop at fixed spacing (one connector per module). For a single contiguous array/plane you run ONE unbroken length of cable along the row(s); each microinverter plugs into its nearest integrated connector. You do NOT field-splice at row transitions - you route the continuous cable up/over to the next row with a SERVICE LOOP (secured with Q-CLIP), and any integrated connector that lands in a gap and is not used gets capped with a Q-SEAL-10 sealing cap. Field-wireable connectors (Q-CONN-10M + Q-CONN-10F) are used ONLY to: (a) rejoin the cable after an intentional CUT, (b) splice / center-feed two separate cable pieces or two reels together, or (c) fabricate a custom-length JUMPER from Q-12-RAW-300 raw cable to bridge a gap LARGER than the fixed connector spacing - e.g., between sub-arrays or across separate roof planes. Cut cable ends that are not joined with a field-wireable connector are closed with a Q-TERM-10 terminator (single-use), not spliced. Datasheet: 'Link connectors eliminate cable waste' and connectors 'make connections from any open connector and center-feed any section of cable within branch limits.'
spliceInstallRule.splicePairDefinition: One 'splice' = one male (Q-CONN-10M) + one female (Q-CONN-10F) field-wireable connector joined together (a jumper across a gap uses one pair per join; a raw-cable jumper needs a connector on each cut end).
spliceInstallRule.source: Enphase IQ Cable accessories Data Sheet DSH-00247-1.0; Enphase Q Cable Terminator Quick Install Guide; Enphase Planning-for-IQ-System tech brief

caveats: SPLICE-RULE CORRECTION (the key finding): the consuming code's assumption of ~1 field-splice pair per (row - 1) is WRONG / far too high. A single contiguous roof plane needs ZERO field splices - the continuous connectorized cable snakes across rows via service loops, with unused connectors capped (Q-SEAL-10). Field splices (Q-CONN male+female pair) occur PER roof-plane / sub-array BRIDGE that exceeds connector spacing, or per intentional cable cut / reel-to-reel join - typically 0-1 per branch, NOT per row. Budget sealing caps (Q-SEAL-10) per unused connector and a Q-TERM-10 per open cable end instead.

Voltage: datasheet lists 277 VAC MAX NOMINAL for the 12 AWG cable/connectors; some distributor listings label the portrait cable '250 VAC'. In US residential the application is 240 VAC split-phase. The '240' in the SKU denotes the 240 V application, not the connector spacing.

ampRating=20 in the cable entries is the 20 A BRANCH OCPD limit (the practical current cap), not a separately published connector ampacity. Enphase does not publish a discrete connector amp rating on this datasheet; the connectors are UL 9703 assemblies approved as the NEC 690 load-break disconnect.

Connector spacing is given two ways: datasheet feet (rounded, e.g. portrait 4.2 ft / landscape 6.5 ft) vs. distributor inches (portrait 51" = 4.25 ft, landscape 78.7" = 6.56 ft). The inch/meter values are exact; the datasheet foot values are rounded.

Prices: portrait Q-12-10-240 $22.29 per inverter-connection (drop) and Q-CONN-10M $138.57/10 ($13.86 ea) from solar-electric.com, retrieved 2026-07-10 - single-distributor retail, not verified against wholesale/other distributors. Landscape cable per-ft, female connector, terminator, sealing-cap, and raw-cable prices were not captured (null). Cable is generally sold PER DROP (per inverter connection), not per foot; per-ft figures are derived (per-drop / spacing-ft).
maxDevicesPerBranch=13 assumes IQ8 / IQ8+ at 240 V. IQ8M (12), IQ8A (10), IQ8H (10) differ - verify against the specific microinverter model datasheet and local AHJ before sizing a branch.
Q-12-RAW-300 (raw 12 AWG, no connectors) is the source stock for field-fabricated jumpers used with Q-CONN-10M/10F to bridge gaps; the datasheet lists it but no length-based price was found.
Also on the accessories datasheet but out of scope here: EN4-to-MC4 DC adapters (ECA-EN4-* / Q-DCC-2 / Q-DCC-2-P for IQ8P) - these are DC-side module leads, not part of the AC trunk.
